title: Phosphorylation enables allosteric control of a viral condensate
authors: Acker J; Wang X; Desirò D; Agarwal T; Colyer A; Haller C; Scrutton R; Sherry L; Saar KL; Murray R; Fominykh K; Chong SH; Schmit JD; Calabrese AN; Knowles TPJ; Borodavka A
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习预测病毒NSP5蛋白的相分离倾向，并研究磷酸化调控凝聚体形成，但核心是蛋白自身相分离而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法部分可借鉴。
abstract: In many viruses, intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) drive the formation of replicative organelles essential for viral production. In species A rotaviruses, the disordered protein NSP5 forms condensates in cells via liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS). Yet the sequence diversity of NSP5 raises the question of whether condensate formation is conserved across all strains and if distinct variants employ alternative mechanisms for nucleating phase separation. Using a machine learning approach, we demonstrate that NSP5 variants differ significantly in their propensity to phase-separate. We engineered a variant incorporating amino acid signatures from strains with low LLPS tendency, which failed to phase separate in vitro yet supported the formation of replicative condensates in recombinant viruses in cells. Low-tendency LLPS strains require phosphorylation of NSP5 to nucleate phase separation, whereas high-tendency strains do not, suggesting distinct nucleation mechanisms. Furthermore, hydrogen-deuterium exchange mass spectrometry revealed a phosphorylation-driven allosteric switch between binding sites on the high-propensity variant. These findings establish that phosphorylation plays a context-dependent role in the formation of replicative organelles across diverse rotaviruses.
abstract_zh: 在许多病毒中， intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) 驱动复制细胞器的形成，这对病毒生产至关重要。在A种轮状病毒中，无序蛋白NSP5通过液-液相分离 (liquid-liquid phase separation, LLPS) 在细胞内形成凝聚体。然而，NSP5的序列多样性引发了一个问题：凝聚体形成是否在所有毒株中保守，以及不同变体是否采用替代机制来启动相分离。通过机器学习方法，我们证明NSP5变体在相分离倾向性上存在显著差异。我们设计了一个包含低LLPS倾向毒株氨基酸特征的变体，该变体在体外未能发生相分离，但在重组病毒中支持细胞内复制凝聚体的形成。低LLPS倾向毒株需要NSP5的磷酸化来启动相分离，而高倾向毒株则不需要，这表明存在不同的启动机制。此外，氢-氘交换质谱揭示了高倾向变体上结合位点之间的磷酸化驱动变构开关。这些发现确立了磷酸化在多种轮状病毒复制细胞器形成中扮演情境依赖的角色。
